ios.desc:
Easily identify unknown callers with CallerSmart’s reverse phone lookup. Enter a phone number and get detailed information about the caller, helping you to recognize and avoid potential spam or scam calls. Whether it's a missed call, a number you don’t recognize, or a suspicious caller, CallerSmart helps you identify who’s on the other end of it.

SMS FILTER AND SPAM CALL BLOCKER

Tired of annoying spam texts and calls? CallerSmart's SMS filters and spam call blocker allows you to block unwanted texts and calls with ease. Say goodbye to the political texts, telemarketers, robocalls, spam texts and scam calls that disrupt your day. Our powerful SMS filters and call blocker ensure that your phone only notifies you when the people who matter are trying to get in touch.

CALLER ID AND CALLER INFORMATION

Know who's calling before you pick up. CallerSmart's Caller ID feature displays the name and other relevant information of incoming calls, giving you the power to decide whether to answer. This feature allows you to manage your calls and ensures you don’t waste time on unwanted calls.

PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY

Your privacy is our top priority. CallerSmart helps you protect your personal information by making it easy for you to add your phone number to the Do Not Call Registry. Keep your personal details safe and avoid sharing your number with unknown callers.

EASY TO USE

CallerSmart features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, making it easy to navigate and use all of its powerful features. Perform reverse phone lookups, block calls, and manage who is calling you with just a few taps.

RELIABLE DATA

Our extensive and regularly updated database ensures you get accurate and reliable information. CallerSmart provides detailed caller information to help you make informed decisions about which calls to answer and which to block.

COMMUNITY-BASED FEEDBACK

Join our active community of users who share information about spam numbers and suspicious callers. Contribute to the community by reporting spam calls and helping others stay protected. CallerSmart relies on community feedback to keep our database up-to-date and reliable.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

- See who has searched your phone number and the phone number of loved ones in the past with our Premium Number Monitoring subscription. Get real-time updates when a number that you care about is searched.
